project.guidance: Use projects for time-bound efforts. Do not invent projects; fetch options and ask when ambiguous.

initiative.guidance: Use initiatives only when strategically relevant or explicitly implied. Do not guess.

estimation.guidance: Use relative complexity, not hours. 1=tiny, 2=small, 3=medium, 5=large, 8=split. Ask when uncertain.

labelGroups.guidance: Every issue must have exactly one domain label. Infer only when clear; otherwise fetch options and ask.

discovery.command: linear context options labels --group domain --output json --compact
discovery.prompt: Which domain label best matches this work?

labelGroups.guidance: Every issue must have exactly one type label. Infer only when clear; otherwise fetch options and ask.

discovery.command: linear context options labels --group type --output json --compact
discovery.prompt: Which type label best matches this work?

labelGroups.guidance: Apply only when this execution-mode label is meaningful for your org.

discovery.command: linear context options labels --group execution --output json --compact

agentInstructions: Default to team EPD when creating issues unless the user specifies another team.
Default new issues to status Spec unless the user specifies another status.
Use `linear i start ISSUE_ID` to begin work, or `linear i update ISSUE_ID -s "STATUS NAME"`; the CLI resolves team-scoped status names to Linear's required stateId UUIDs.
Issue creation requires exactly_one label group 'domain' (Which domain label best matches this work?); infer only when clear, otherwise fetch options and ask the user.
Issue creation requires exactly_one label group 'type' (Which type label best matches this work?); infer only when clear, otherwise fetch options and ask the user.
Use the configured estimation rubric; infer only when reasonably clear and ask when uncertain.
Do not invent projects, initiatives, or labels; fetch options and ask when ambiguous.
